rules.name: Do not import unused types
rules.fix: 删除未使用的 import（禁止注释保留）

rules.name: Public class Javadoc with description and @since
rules.fix: 顶层 public 类 Javadoc 补功能说明与 @since

rules.name: Block brace on line end / closing brace on own line
rules.fix: 非空块右大括号另起一行（statement; } → statement;\n}）

rules.name: One statement per line
rules.fix: 一行多语句拆行（如 ;};}); → 分行）

rules.name: Format spacing around braces and lambda arrow
rules.fix: '; }' 去多余空格；') ->' / '-> {' lambda 补空格；'{ stmt' 块体换行

rules.name: Single empty line between copyright, package, imports and class
rules.fix: 版权/package/import/类声明之间仅保留 1 空行

rules.name: No vertical alignment with multiple spaces
rules.fix: lambda '->  ' 等连续多空格收敛为单空格

rules.name: Block comment indent matches context
rules.fix: 类内 @tc Javadoc 续行补 ' *' 对齐（非 '/*' 紧贴）

rules.name: Method Javadoc multi-line with description
rules.fix: 单行 /** ... */ 方法注释展开为多行

rules.name: Do not hide class field with local variable
rules.fix: 类字段与局部变量同名时重命名类字段为 sharedXxx

rules.name: Declare local variables near first use
rules.fix: 声明与首次使用间隔 >10 行时将声明移至使用前；Object resultObj=null + assertNull 下沉到 assert 前

rules.name: Do not catch Exception or RuntimeException
rules.fix: 按 assertEqual 期望异常类型收窄 catch

rules.name: Avoid throw raw Error in test code
rules.fix: throw new Error(...) → BasTest.throwTestError(...)

rules.name: Missing javadoc on public/protected member
rules.fix: public/protected 成员补简短 Javadoc

rules.name: Conditional and loop blocks must use braces
rules.fix: 单行 if/for/while 补 { } 块

rules.name: Each line has a maximum of 120 half-width characters
rules.fix: 超长行折行（@tc.desc / 长实参）

rules.name: Missing empty line between code and comment
rules.fix: '}' 与 @tc Javadoc 之间补空行

rules.name: Class/interface/enum must be named in upperCamelCase style
rules.fix: DummyObj_038 → DummyObj038

rules.name: Should assign Locale when using String.toLowerCase/toUpperCase
rules.fix: toLowerCase() → toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT)

rules.name: Do not directly use == for floating point Infinity
rules.fix: == Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY → Double.isInfinite(x) && x > 0

rules.name: Do not assign value to method parameter
rules.fix: 参数赋值：lc→localeKey；amount→amountIn+局部副本等

rules.name: Avoid empty code blocks
rules.fix: 空 for/while（含仅注释）插入 continue;（支持嵌套括号）

rules.name: Avoid overload primitive and wrapper
rules.fix: BasTest 删除 assertEqual(int, Integer)；新增 assertEqualInt(int, Number) 消歧

rules.name: Do not modify field with public which is not final
rules.fix: EntryResult/IteratorResult public 字段加 final

rules.name: Non-constant field lowerCamelCase
rules.fix: lambda 占位 $xN/_a 改合法标识符；private static int INT8_MAX 等 UPPER 字段改为 private static final
